description: Pre-registered comparative evaluation matrix and ablation study protocol for RT-05D1 / RT-07 with explicit 420 planned episode identities.

primary_baselines.description: Deterministic rule-based baseline operating over canonical eligible proposals.
Pure LLM semantic candidate selection baseline under controlled inference configuration.
Proposed research method: LLM semantic ranking fused with deterministic progression, noise, step, repetition, and failure scoring.

ablation_configurations.research_question: Does explicit operational-noise cost reasoning affect covertness and containment avoidance in enterprise networks?
Do repetition and observable failure penalties improve dead-end recovery and prevent cyclic re-exploitation attempts?
How does LLM candidate ranking perform when stripped of all deterministic symbolic progression and cost grounding?
How much benchmark performance is achieved by deterministic symbolic progression and penalty scoring alone without LLM semantic ranking?

execution_invariant: Comparative benchmark must NOT be executed until formal RT-07 authorization.
